description: This file defines the DetailedMenuItem class within the OrangeHRM system. It models detailed menu items with properties like ID, title, module, screen, additional parameters, and child menu items. It includes methods for creating instances from MenuItem objects, managing child menu items, and accessing properties.

classes.name: DetailedMenuItem
classes.description: Represents a detailed menu item with properties such as id, title, module, screen, additional parameters, and child items. Provides methods to create instances from MenuItem objects, manage child menu items, and retrieve property values.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the menu item.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the menu item.

methods.name: getMenuTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the menu item.

methods.name: setMenuTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the menu item.

methods.name: getAdditionalParams
methods.description: Returns any additional parameters associated with the menu item.

methods.name: setAdditionalParams
methods.description: Sets additional parameters for the menu item.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the module name associated with the menu item.

methods.name: setModule
methods.description: Sets the module name for the menu item.

methods.name: getScreen
methods.description: Returns the screen URL or identifier associated with this menu item.

methods.name: setScreen
methods.description: Sets the screen URL or identifier.

methods.name: createFromMenuItem
methods.description: Creates a DetailedMenuItem object from a MenuItem entity, extracting relevant data including module and screen info.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a child DetailedMenuItem to this menu item.

methods.name: getChildMenuItems
methods.description: Returns an array of child menu items.
